body.name: Bounded-outcome interval-tension completion
body.construction: \(\mathcal Q_Y(\mu)=\{\beta\in\mathbb R^{\mathcal V}:\mu_e-u_e\le(B^{\mathsf T}\beta)_e\le\mu_e-\ell_e\text{ for }e\in\mathcal E,\ \underline y\le\alpha_h+\lambda_t\le\overline y\text{ for }(h,t)\in\mathcal K\}\), and \(\mathcal A_Y(\mu)=\{\mu-B^{\mathsf T}\beta:\beta\in\mathcal Q_Y(\mu)\}\).
